title: JOINs
explain: A JOIN combines rows from two tables using a matching column. INNER JOIN keeps only the matches, while LEFT JOIN keeps every row from the left table and fills gaps with NULL. Joins let you store each fact once and still combine it later.
exercise: List each course with the number of students in it, including courses that have none.
tip: Forgetting the ON condition gives a cross join, where every row pairs with every other row. Row counts explode fast.
